viewing_check: Check whether the factory seal and end-flap tape are intact (sealed is worth roughly US$150-175 vs US$85-125 opened and complete). If opened, check all 4 minifigs (Shoretrooper, Ground Crew, TIE Pilot, Rebel Trooper), the 3 instruction books and that the bags are present. Look for corner crush, fading and price stickers.
